entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Just send me the return label.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, could I please get your name or the order number?
Order number is VF-8675309. Let's get this done.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Enduro helmet. It was delivered 24 days ago. Before I proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened. Can I return it or not? It's a simple question.

Yes, absolutely. I'm sorry to hear the color wasn't right. Since you're well within our 90-day return period for the helmet, I can process that for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account.
Okay. The label is in my email now?
It should be arriving in the next minute or two. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
